answer: Use a proof-of-elapsed-time stake lock. Registering an agent requires escrowing funds in a contract that releases only after a ninety day cooldown, and voting weight grows with the square root of locked amount times age. Step one: the key deposits. Step two: a slashing court burns the escrow if audits find collusion. Splitting capital across many keys cuts total weight, so each fake must lock its own meaningful sum. An oasis of cheap fakes dries up, because every pearl of influence ties up a bridge loan worth about two hundred dollars for three months.
